annotations.title: Build GovCon Oral Presentation Deck, Live Tech-Demo Runbook & Murder-Board Q&A

description: Generate a FAR 15.102 & Shipley Phase-II Oral Presentation slide-by-slide blueprint, Key Personnel speaker-attributed talking points, a minute-by-minute Live Technical Demonstration / Scenario Challenge runbook with zero-downtime failover contingencies, an adversarial SSEB 'Murder Board' Q&A coaching matrix, and evaluator caucus takeaways from RFP Section L/M oral instructions. This is a read-only, stateless generative preparation call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `rfp_oral_instructions_and_sow_text` accepts 30 to 120,000 characters, `proposed_solution_and_key_personnel` maps slides strictly to eligible Key Personnel speakers, optional `known_incumbent_and_risk_areas` sharpens Murder-Board trap questions, and `presentation_format_mode` selects 'COMBINED_ORALS_TECH_DEMO_AND_QA' [default], 'EXECUTIVE_SLIDE_BRIEFING_AND_QA', 'LIVE_TECHNICAL_SCENARIO_CHALLENGE', or 'KEY_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_AND_CAUCUS'). Use this tool when preparing for Phase-II advisory down-select oral presentations, live technical demonstrations, or SSEB Q&A caucuses; use `generate_rfp_response` instead for written Volume I Technical Approach prose, or `match_key_personnel` for written Volume II resumes and Letters of Commitment.

bidder_solution_and_key_personnel_contex.description: Proposed Key Personnel names/roles/clearances, technical architecture, past performance metrics, and competitive win themes to weave into the speaker scripts and Murder-Board Q&A answers.

presentation_format.description: Oral evaluation format: 'far_15_102_oral_technical_proposal' (default Federal FAR 15.102 / GSA FEDSIM Phase II Orals), 'live_technical_demo_and_coding_challenge' (hands-on tech demo & scenario execution), 'executive_key_personnel_orals_and_qna' (Key Personnel oral defense), or 'sled_finalist_vendor_interview' (State/Local BAFO interview).

rfp_oral_instructions_and_sow_text.description: Raw RFP Section L Oral Presentation / Live Tech-Demo rules (time limits, slide limits, speaker eligibility restrictions under FAR 15.102, live scenario prompts), Section M evaluation criteria, and PWS/SOW technical scope (30 to 120,000 characters).

total_session_minutes.description: Total scheduled duration of the oral presentation, live demo, and Q&A session in minutes (15 to 240; defaults to 90).

name: generate_oral_presentation_prep

closing_evaluator_leave_behind_pitch.description: Final 60-second executive closing statement designed to anchor 'High Confidence / Multiple Significant Strengths' before the SSEB caucuses.

key_personnel_speaker_choreography.description: Rules of engagement and handoff choreography ensuring every Key Personnel speaker demonstrates deep technical mastery without talking over teammates.

live_tech_demo_runbook.description: Step-by-step live technical demonstration runbook with operator actions, evaluator strength callouts, and offline failover contingencies.

murder_board_qna_bank.description: Adversarial SSEB Murder-Board questions with hidden evaluator concerns, responder roles, gold-standard answers, and traps to avoid.

recommended_time_budget_breakdown.description: Minute-by-minute time allocation across Opening/Intros, Core Technical Slides, Live Demo, Caucus Buffer, and Q&A.

slide_deck_blueprint.description: Slide-by-slide Shipley oral presentation blueprint with action captions, speaker assignments, visual concepts, and verbatim scripts.

solicitation_and_format_summary.description: Identified solicitation title/ID, oral format, speaker restrictions, and Section M evaluation hierarchy.

title: Build GovCon Oral Presentation Deck, Live Tech-Demo Runbook & Murder-Board Q&A
